name: Sweet Squid 86
author: Showbizfleet
description: Gradient purple button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes 0px 4px 8px #000000, inset 0px -2px 0px #ffffff. On focus, the outline is removed.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sweet Squid 86</title>
<style>
/* Sweet Squid 86 by Showbizfleet — https://uiverse.io/Showbizfleet/sweet-squid-86 */
button {
  height: 50px;
  margin: 5px;
  width: 120px;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #9c27b0, #f44336, #ff9800, #ffc107, #8bc34a, #4caf50, #2196f3, #03a9f4, #00bcd4, #009688);
  background-size: 200%;
  background-position: 0%;
  box-shadow: 0px 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), inset 0px -1px 0px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

button:hover {
  background-position: 100%;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), inset 0px -2px 0px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

button:focus {
  outline: none;
}

button:active {
  background-size: 100%;
  box-shadow: 0px 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), inset 0px -1px 0px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
